title: Package lookup
subtitle: Look a package up on the external catalog before it is pulled in, and see whether it is already in use internally.

not_found.title: Nothing found under that name
not_found.description: Check the ecosystem and the exact package name. The external catalog only answers exact matches.

disabled.title: This deployment does not look packages up externally
disabled.description: An administrator can turn this on by setting EXTERNAL_PACKAGE_LOOKUP_ENABLED.

errors.lookup_failed: The package could not be looked up.
